name: Sovereign AI Audit
audience: Regulated SMBs who want a professional review of their AI drafting sovereignty before they buy.
pain: Buyers aren't sure if a local-first suite will actually fit their compliance posture. They want an expert check first.
offer: Fixed-fee ($297) 1-hour sovereignty audit: we review your current AI drafting setup (cloud exposure, billing, audit logs, compliance gaps) and deliver a prioritized remediation report. Credits $297 toward any product purchase.
headline: Know your sovereignty gaps before you buy. 1-hour expert audit, $297 credited toward any suite.
cross_sell: Credits toward Sentinel Note, OpsDraft, LedgerDraft, HRDraft, or Sovereign Supercharger.

faq.a: A prioritized remediation report + 1-hour call. The $297 is credited if you buy any product.

faq.q: Do you need access to my systems?
faq.a: No. You run the free Readiness Score script and share the report; we analyze it.
